title: General repealer.
bodyText: Except as provided in the following section, all acts and parts of acts inconsistent with this chapter are hereby repealed.
bodyHtml: §490:10-103  General repealer.  Except as provided in the following section, all acts and parts of acts inconsistent with this chapter are hereby repealed. [L 1965, c 208, §10-103; HRS §490:10-103]
